title: ExecutionStamp
description:
STORY-035-12. The immutable execution stamp: the final accepted ROUTE decision plus task-policy inputs, stamped into a story before an attempt runs. It carries the accepted or deliberately-overridden ExecutionProfile (execution-profile.schema.json) fields that stampvalidate.ValidateFinal needs to re-check every hard rule against, plus enough task identity to check forbidden_for. It does NOT carry a resolved physical placement - that is a separate, ephemeral PlacementEvidence supplied at validation time (placement-evidence.schema.json), never part of this document (amendment 2).

The property set is CLOSED (additionalProperties: false) and frozen by STORY-035-12 amendment 4. `expires_at` MUST be copied UNCHANGED from the accepted /v1/route decision: creating or overriding a stamp never grants a fresh validity window. `override`, when present, is AUDIT PROVENANCE ONLY - it grants no bypass of any rule; the final stamped fields here are validated on their own merits regardless of whether an override produced them.

harness.description: Same vocabulary and meaning as ExecutionProfile.harness. This is the FINAL stamped value - after any override - not necessarily what the router itself recommended.

model_profile.description: Same vocabulary and meaning as ExecutionProfile.model_profile. The FINAL stamped value.

cost_class.description: Same vocabulary and meaning as ExecutionProfile.cost_class: the economics of THIS ATTEMPT.

entitlement_pool.description: Same vocabulary and meaning as ExecutionProfile.entitlement_pool. null for local execution, which draws on no pool.

metered.description: States INTENT ONLY (STORY-035-12 amendment 3). This field alone never authorizes billable spend; spend authority is established independently, at validation time, in ValidationContext - never derived from this stamp. A stamp cannot mint its own authority by setting this true.

placement_policy.description: Same vocabulary and meaning as ExecutionProfile.placement_policy: which policy a later /v1/place call (and the placement rules in the frozen validation-verdict) must resolve this attempt under.

placement_required.description: Same meaning as ExecutionProfile.placement_required. When true, validation requires a matching, fresh PlacementEvidence; when false (every vendor-hosted profile), PlacementEvidence must be ABSENT - its presence is itself a validation failure (vendor_profile_with_placement).

catalog_version.description: The catalog digest this stamp was computed against. Validation fails closed (catalog_version_stale) the instant this differs from the digest of the catalog actually loaded at validation time - never re-interpreted against a newer catalog, even when the stamped pair also exists there.

catalog_document_version.description: Additive, optional, audit-only (present exactly when ExecutionProfile carried it). No frozen validation rule reads this field; catalog_version (the digest) is the only value ever compared for drift.

expires_at.description: RFC 3339. Copied UNCHANGED from the accepted /v1/route decision's own expires_at (STORY-035-12 amendment 4) - stamping or overriding a route never computes a fresh 24-hour window. Validation's not_expired check compares the injected `now` against this value alone; `created_at` below never extends it.

task.description: Task/story identity and the policy-bearing tags forbidden_for is checked against (STORY-035-12 amendment 4).

override.description: Nullable pre-stamp override audit record (STORY-035-12 amendment 4). null when the stamp is the router's own unmodified recommendation. Present when a human deliberately overrode the recommendation before stamping (ADE-BOUNDARY.md §7) - PROVENANCE ONLY: it grants no bypass of any validation rule. An override that would produce a combination the router itself could never emit (a forbidden_for match, an unapproved pair, an undeclared entitlement) fails validation exactly as if the router had proposed it directly.

created_at.description: Optional, audit only (STORY-035-12 amendment 4). Records when this stamp document was written. It does NOT reset or extend route validity - only expires_at governs the not_expired check, however recently created_at claims the stamp to be.

story_id.description: Identifies which attempt this is - the same story_id RouteRequest carried when this stamp's route was decided.

title.description: Optional human-readable task title, carried for audit legibility only.

tags.description: The task's tags, exactly as RouteRequest.tags carried them. Checked against the stamped profile's catalog forbidden_for list (rule 2, forbidden_for): a match is a hard exclusion regardless of how the stamp came to name that profile, override included.

actor.description: Who performed the override - a human identity, for audit.

at.description: RFC 3339. When the override decision was made - distinct from, and never a substitute for, this stamp's own expires_at or created_at.

original.description: What the router itself recommended before the override - preserved so a reader can tell "router recommendation accepted" from "explicit operator override" (contracts/agent-router/README.md, '/v1/route is recommendation-only').

reason.description: Why the operator overrode the recommendation - required, because an unexplained override is exactly the audit gap this record exists to close.

override.description: Pre-stamp override audit record. Grants no bypass of any validation rule (STORY-035-12 amendment 4/6): the FINAL stamped harness/model_profile/etc. fields at the top level of this document are what every rule validates, on their own merits.
